question: We run a trucking terminal and fuel our own tank trucks. The rule leaves transportation-related facilities to DOT as drawn in a memorandum of understanding between the Secretary of Transportation and the EPA Administrator alone. What is that memorandum's date?

EPA's regional office made a final determination that our otherwise-exempt warehouse must prepare an SPCC Plan, and we appealed to the EPA Administrator. Within how many days of receiving the appeal must the Administrator decide?
answer: within 60 days of receiving the appeal

question: The Regional Administrator sent us written notice that our small fuel yard must prepare an SPCC Plan although we thought we were exempt. How many days after receiving it do we have to send information and consult with EPA?
answer: within 30 days of receipt of the notice

question: Our warehouse keeps a few drums and one small diesel tank above ground. At or below what aggregate aboveground oil storage capacity is a facility exempt from the SPCC rule?
Our fuel depot is run by a federal agency. Under which section of the Clean Water Act are federal departments subject to the SPCC rule to the same extent as any person?
answer: section 313 of the Clean Water Act

question: The spill rule keeps referring to the navigable waters near our terminal. Which section of the chapter does its definition of navigable waters point to?

The Regional Administrator sent us, by certified mail, a proposed amendment to our terminal's SPCC Plan. How many days from receipt do we have to submit written information, views and arguments on it?
plan: amendment of plan by regional administrator
answer: within 30 days from receipt of the notice

question: Our warehouse fuel tanks have been in service since the nineties. For a facility in operation on or before what date does the five-year Plan review run from the date the last review was required?
plan: amendment of plan by owners or operators

question: We store vegetable oil in elevated, shop-built austenitic stainless steel tanks with no external insulation, which may get formal visual inspection instead of integrity testing. Which FDA regulation must those tanks be subject to (title and part of the CFR)?

We are building a new fuel terminal that must submit a facility response plan before it starts operating. Changes made during start-up go to the Regional Administrator after an operational trial period of how many days?
answer: after an operational trial period of 60 days

question: Our trucking terminal's SPCC Plan skips the discharge-reporting procedures because we submitted a facility response plan instead. That response plan needs a planning scenario for a small discharge: up to how many gallons?
answer: a discharge of 2,100 gallons or less

question: We put no secondary containment around the transformers and hydraulic systems in our warehouse, and for them we rely on our facility response plan instead of a separate contingency plan. That response plan's medium discharge scenario tops out at how many gallons, unless a share of the largest tank is smaller?
answer: up to 36,000 gallons, or ten percent of the largest tank if that is less

question: Dikes around our bulk tanks are not practicable, so we planned to rely on a facility response plan rather than a contingency plan. A facility with very large storage must file such a plan if its reportable spill history includes a discharge of at least how many gallons within the last five years?
answer: a reportable discharge of 10,000 gallons or more within the last five years

question: We are setting up the response training and drill program that must be described in our facility response plan. If we disagree with the Regional Administrator's determination about that response plan, how many days after his notice do we have to request reconsideration?
answer: within 60 days of receipt of the notice

question: Our facility response plan must describe our drill and exercise program as the training-and-drills section lays it out. A program following the national PREP is deemed satisfactory; which section of appendix E says where to get it?

The definitions measure the maximum extent practicable against the response plan our tank farm must meet. If we change the type of oil we store in a way that alters the response resources needed, within how many days must we resubmit the revised portions of that response plan?

Our Plan uses alternative methods in place of some requirements, and the Regional Administrator may make us amend it under his amendment procedures. If we appeal his decision requiring the amendment, within how many days of the notice must the appeal go to the EPA Administrator?
answer: in writing within 30 days of receipt of the notice

question: Our Plan may not deviate from the onshore section's secondary containment rules. When we drain rainwater from a diked area past the treatment system, the event records may be those required by permits under which section of the chapter?
answer: permits issued under § 122.41 of the chapter

question: Our onshore warehouse must meet the general Plan requirements. If dikes around our tanks are impracticable and we have no response plan, our oil spill contingency plan must follow which part of the chapter?
plan: section 112.8 plan requirements for onshore facilities

question: We keep diesel for our trucks on land where we also raise cattle, so the farm deadline for the Plan may apply to us. To count as a farm, the land must have produced and sold agricultural products worth at least how much in a year?
plan: requirement to prepare and implement a plan

question: The definitions say the SPCC Plan is the document required by the section on preparing it. Our onshore terminal must also file a facility response plan and has operated since the nineties. By what date did we have to amend and implement our Plan?

The section on amendments the Regional Administrator can require after spills does not apply to us until our initial Plan deadline has passed. We are an onshore warehouse (not a farm, no offshore part, no response plan) that opened after the rule's original cutoff but before its later compliance deadline. By what date did we have to prepare and implement our Plan?
plan: amendment of plan by regional administrator

question: To complete the Tier I template we certify that our facility meets the Tier I qualification criteria. Under those criteria, no individual aboveground container may be larger than what capacity?

The qualified-facilities section sends Tier II facilities to the Tier II criteria. To qualify, a facility must not have had a single discharge larger than how many gallons in the three years before self-certification?

A Professional Engineer must certify our Plan unless the qualified-facilities section lets us self-certify. As a self-certified Tier II facility, above what aggregate aboveground capacity must we switch to an engineer-certified Plan?
plan: requirement to prepare and implement a plan

question: We are amending our self-certified Plan for a technical change, and the amendment rule sends qualified facilities to their own section instead of a Professional Engineer. We are Tier I: installing a container larger than what capacity takes us out of Tier I?
plan: amendment of plan by owners or operators

question: As a Tier I warehouse our overfill rule stands in for the one in the onshore-facility section. That onshore section requires corrosion protection for completely buried metallic tanks installed on or after what date?

Our Tier I containment rule replaces the bulk-storage containment paragraphs of the onshore-facility section. In that onshore section, buried piping installed or replaced on or after what date needs a protective wrapping and coating?

After two spills within a year at our terminal we must report to the Regional Administrator, counting only discharges as described in the general-applicability section. Harmful quantities there are as described in which part of the chapter?
plan: amendment of plan by regional administrator

question: Our onshore warehouse must meet the general Plan requirements, and its discharge-reporting procedures are covered by the facility response plan we submitted instead. If the Regional Administrator denies our request to reconsider a decision about that response plan, within how many days must we appeal to the EPA Administrator?
plan: section 112.8 plan requirements for onshore facilities
answer: in writing within 60 days of receipt of the denial

question: We store vegetable oil in bulk and must meet the general Plan requirements, with our emergency procedures handled by our facility response plan. For animal fat and vegetable oil facilities whose submitted but unapproved response plan fell short of the revised rules, by what date was a new plan due?

Our Plan follows the general requirements, and since dikes are not practicable around our tanks we rely on our facility response plan. That response plan should be coordinated with the local emergency plan developed under which section of Title III of the Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act?
plan: requirement to prepare and implement a plan

question: Our Tier I Plan follows the general Plan requirements, and EPA can make us amend it under the Regional Administrator's amendment procedures. Once a large spill makes that section apply, within how many days must we send the Regional Administrator our facility information?

We are amending our Plan under the general requirements, and our facility diagram must mark our underground diesel tank as exempt. That tank is exempt when it meets all the technical requirements of which part of the chapter, or of a State program approved under which part?
plan: amendment of plan by owners or operators
answer: part 280, or a State program approved under part 281

question: Our Plan follows the general requirements, and our facility diagram has to show certain pipelines marked as exempt. Intra-facility gathering lines are exempt when subject to which DOT pipeline regulations (CFR title and parts)?
plan: requirement to prepare and implement a plan

question: How much does our state charge each year to register an underground fuel storage tank?
plan: state underground storage tank registration fee

question: Which hazard placard and identification number must our diesel tank truck display on the highway?
plan: tank truck placard diesel hazardous materials

question: How many hours may a property-carrying truck driver drive after a full break off duty?
What is the minimum width of an exit route in our warehouse?
How often must the portable fire extinguishers in our warehouse be visually inspected?
